newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Regent says mgt buy-out complete, IPO in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Regent says mgt buy-out complete, IPO in Oct.

text.p: Regent Pacific Group Ltd said a management buy-out has been completed and the company will launch an initial public offering worth US$70 million at the end of October for mid-November listing in Hong Kong.
"We are now 41 percent owned by management and staff," managing director Jim Mellon told Reuters in an interview.
A number of institutions hold the remaining 51 percent, but Mellon is Regent's largest shareholder with a 16 percent stake followed by one unidentified investor with seven percent.
Altamira, the Canadian mutual fund giant, agreed to sell its 64-percent majority holding in Regent to Regent's management through a loan note.
